method: Agent-assisted live browser interaction through the in-app browser; real local Django server and isolated synthetic SQLite database. Not an independent participant study.
session_isolation: Separate loopback host cookies; staff uttam and hospital abhinav were logged in simultaneously.

checks.check: Live STAT alert without staff reload
checks.before: Hidden alert; 0 pending requests; staff queue empty.
checks.action: Hospital submits B+ RBC quantity 2, required-by 6 November, STAT checked.
checks.after: Staff unchanged page shows 1 pending Emergency / STAT request require review.
checks.timing_limit: Observation upper bound includes control/inspection overhead, not exact network-to-paint latency or a strict <=5s measurement.
checks.queue_note: Alert updates live; table rows remain static until Open review queue is clicked. Link then shows the request.

checks.observed: b/Enter selects B+; r/Enter selects RBC. End selects Reject; submission without a reason shows A rejection reason is required and status stays Pending. Home selects Approve; Tab/Return records review and status Approved.

checks.check: Cross-match, FEFO, partial dispatch and hospital receipt
checks.observed: BAG-ABHINAV-01 compatible; earlier-expiry bag reserved and dispatched with manifest. Hospital Space/Tab/Return confirms receipt. Tracking shows Delivered with abhinav receiver/server timestamp; request stays Partially Fulfilled, 2 requested/1 dispatched, 1 remaining.
Hospital logout returns home with success message and anonymous navigation.

checks.check: Registration validation and corrected adult submission
checks.observed: Synthetic Abhinav Navaneeth; 2015-01-01 DOB shows explicit under-age field error and preserves non-secret fields. Corrected 1999-01-01 DOB with re-entered password submits via Tab/Return and reaches donor dashboard. No first-time human timing claim.
Profile edit stores synthetic address and B+ via keyboard selection/submit. History shows no previous donations and 90-day interval; medical screening remains separately required.
Staff queue contains only BAG-UTTAM-UNSAFE, 1.0 days, count 1. Status History shows initial Quarantined event, uttam and server time.

contrast_method: Read computed colors from rendered DOM and effective opaque background; sRGB relative luminance, alpha compositing before luminance. Sampled text pairs only, not a full WCAG audit.
not_verified: Complete keyboard/assistive-technology and all contrast states audit
